title: Choosing an apartment to share
prompt: You and your brother are going to rent a place together in Metro Vancouver. Decide which home you would prefer, and then persuade your brother, who has his eye on the other one, to agree with your decision.

options.title: Two-bedroom apartment in Richmond
details: 5-minute walk to a Canada Line SkyTrain station
Fourth floor with a small balcony
Shared laundry room in the building; built in 1985

options.title: Two-bedroom townhouse in Langley
details: Private backyard and one parking spot
Nearest bus stop is a 15-minute walk

structure: Choose the Richmond apartment and recognise what your brother likes about the townhouse.
Show that the real cost difference is small (utilities, car costs).
Main argument: transit and commuting time, with a concrete example.
Respond to the laundry/backyard point and finish with a confident request.
modelAnswer: Minh, I know the townhouse looks great, especially the backyard and the in-suite laundry, but I really think we should go with the apartment in Richmond. First, the price gap isn't as big as it looks. The townhouse is $250 cheaper, but utilities are extra, about $180 a month, so we'd only save around seventy dollars. And the biggest issue is location. The apartment is a five-minute walk from the SkyTrain, so we can both get downtown in about half an hour without a car. From the townhouse, the closest bus stop is fifteen minutes away, which means one of us would basically need a car, and with insurance, gas and parking, that'll cost way more than seventy dollars. Sure, sharing a laundry room is a bit annoying, but it's just once a week. And we'll still have a balcony for our plants and a barbecue. So honestly, the apartment saves us time, money and stress. Let's call the landlord today before someone else takes it.

usefulExpressions.expression: I really think we should go with…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Mình thật sự nghĩ chúng ta nên chọn… — nêu lựa chọn rõ ràng

usefulExpressions.expression: The price gap isn't as big as it looks
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Chênh lệch giá không lớn như vẻ ngoài — phản bác lập luận về giá

usefulExpressions.expression: …which means one of us would basically need…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Điều đó có nghĩa là… — chỉ ra hậu quả của phương án kia
Đúng là…, nhưng… — nhượng bộ một điểm rồi giảm nhẹ nó

usefulExpressions.expression: So honestly, … saves us time, money and stress
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Tóm tắt lợi ích bằng bộ ba (rule of three) trước khi kết

commonMistakes: Chỉ so sánh giá thuê mà quên các chi phí ẩn (utilities, xe hơi); người chấm đánh giá cao lập luận có tính toán.
Dùng 'cheap' cho căn hộ đắt hơn hoặc nói 'more cheaper'; đúng là 'cheaper' / 'less expensive'.
Kết thúc lửng lơ; nên có câu kêu gọi hành động (Let's call the landlord today).

review.notes: Rendered and inspected the picture/cards; checked the model answer against the drawing, length (60 s), task fulfilment, expressions and mistakes. Changes: Raised rents to 2026 Metro Vancouver levels ($2,850 / $2,600), keeping the $250 gap the answer relies on.
